title: Product Designer, Point of Sale
description:
Location(s): US (remote), Boston (hybrid), or New York (hybrid) - EST preferred

Toast creates technology to help restaurants and local businesses succeed in a digital world, helping business owners operate, increase sales, engage customers, and keep employees happy.
At Toast , we don't just build software; we power the heartbeat of local communities. As a Product Designer on the Point of Sale team, you will shape the experiences that sit at the center of every restaurant's operation, the tools servers, bartenders, and front-of-house staff rely on hundreds of times a day to deliver excellent hospitality. Your mission is to make those moments fast, intuitive, and reliable, no matter how busy the floor gets.
Working within the POS team, you will partner with research, product, and engineering peers to turn complex operational workflows into seamless experiences across Toast 's terminal and handheld surfaces. You'll immerse yourself in the fast-paced reality of restaurant service to understand the "why" behind every tap, swipe, and order modification, using your design expertise to create tools that help restaurant staff move with confidence, reduce errors, and focus on what matters most: the guest.
We are looking for a designer with a Founder's Mentality: someone who takes uncompromising ownership of their domain and has a relentless commitment to customer success. If you are ready to master your craft and help build the future of restaurant operations, we want you on the line with us.
A day in the life (Responsibilities)

• Own and drive the end-to-end design process for Point of Sale experiences, moving from early discovery and concept development through high-fidelity execution with strong autonomy.

• Translate complex operational workflows - order taking, modifications, payments, splits, and voids - into experiences that are fast, error-resistant, and easy to learn on the fly.

• Design for the realities of restaurant service: high-pressure environments, time-sensitive decisions, and users who can't stop and read instructions during a dinner rush.

• Partner closely with Product, Engineering, and Research to define how POS capabilities come to life across terminal and handheld surfaces, balancing technical constraints with user needs.

• Create polished, high-fidelity artifacts that account for edge cases, hardware contexts, and the full range of restaurant types and service styles Toast supports.

• Make work visible early and often, using prototypes and storytelling to build alignment and communicate tradeoffs across cross-functional partners.

• Champion the server and front-of-house perspective in every design decision, ensuring that speed, clarity, and reliability are never compromised.

• Contribute to design critiques and team collaboration, and integrate emerging AI-first tools and methods into your practice to accelerate exploration and execution.

What you'll need to thrive (Requirements)

• You have a demonstrated ability to use data and insights, including business metrics and user research, to substantiate design decisions and drive impact.

• You hold a high bar for design excellence. Your portfolio shows a disciplined process that accounts for fine details, edge cases, and complex real-world constraints.

• You are innately collaborative and actively manage stakeholders. Your collaborative style inspires others, and you build the dependability needed to enact influence with cross-functional partners.

• You excel at untangling ambiguity, breaking down complex workflows into intuitive, end-to-end user journeys.

• You understand what it means to design for speed and reliability - your instinct is to reduce friction, not add features.

• You take an AI-first design approach to quickly create conceptual prototypes but also possess strong visual design skills to polish beautiful and intuitive end-to-end journeys across multiple surfaces.

• 3+ years in product design, showing clear progression from executing task

From day one, you'll be working with an experienced founding team, backed by a $32M Series B led by Khosla Ventures and Plural, alongside other renowned investors.

Monumental is based in the city centre of Amsterdam, in a beautiful facility with a fully equipped workshop and robot testing floor. We build the whole stack in-house, hardware and software. Our work involves building robots in our workshop and houses on real construction sites, so we're onsite five days a week.

Read more on why we believe you should spend your time working on construction, and learn about our vision https://www.monumental.co/our-vision/ and company https://www.monumental.co/about/. ABOUT THE ROLE

We’re looking for a Finance Ops Associate to help run the financial operations behind Monumental. You’ll work closely with our finance and operations teams, building practical experience in invoice processing, month-end closing and financial administration.

This is a role for someone near the start of their career who enjoys working with numbers and wants to understand how a company runs. You don’t need a background in robotics or construction. Curiosity, care with details and a willingness to ask questions matter.

Your work will help suppliers get paid on time, colleagues make informed decisions and the company keep financial records it can trust. Some tasks are repetitive and require patience. You’ll also help improve the processes behind them, so recurring problems get fixed.

Finance operations will be your main focus, alongside occasional projects such as researching a supplier, preparing an analysis or helping set up a new process. As you learn the business, you’ll take on greater responsibility and more complex work.

 

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Process supplier invoices. Check invoices against orders and supporting documents, assign the right categories, resolve discrepancies and gather approvals so payments can be made on time.

- Support the monthly close. Reconcile transactions, check that invoices and expenses are recorded in the right period, and follow up on outstanding items alongside the finance team.

- Keep financial records organised. Maintain supplier details, receipts and expense records. Help prepare customer invoices, track payments and answer questions from colleagues and suppliers.

- Improve how we work. Spot recurring errors, document processes and use software and AI to reduce manual work, checking the results carefully.

- Contribute to broader projects. Help the operations team with research, analysis and process improvements as priorities arise, while keeping finance operations as your core responsibility.

- An interest in finance and business. You want to build a strong foundation in financial operations. You might be a recent graduate or have around a year of work experience.

- Care with numbers. You can work through an invoice or spreadsheet, notice when something doesn’t add up and investigate it.

- Organisation and follow-through. You track deadlines, follow up on missing information and flag when priorities conflict.

- We lean in: ownership over titles, outcomes over intentions.

- We fight for excellence: high standards, direct, ego-free feedback.

- We grow together: as a team and with our customers.

Mission before ego. Everyone contributes. No one coasts.

If you’re driven by impact, pace, and raising the bar. This is the place.

THE ROLE

This role is a hands-on GTM Systems Analyst or Senior GTM Systems Analyst position responsible for building and optimizing the company’s revenue systems infrastructure, primarily through Salesforce configuration/development and integrations across the broader GTM tech stack to support scalable sales, marketing, and customer success operations.

WHO YOU ARE

Must Haves

• Strong hands-on Salesforce Sales Cloud configuration experience
• Experience building automation and workflows in Salesforce
• Experience working with multiple GTM tools and integrations (ex: Gong, marketing tools, CPQ, billing)
• Experience supporting or scaling Salesforce in a startup or high-growth environment
• Sound judgment on when a quick fix is enough and when a scalable solution is worth the extra time.
• Treats GTM teams as customers: communicates clearly with non-technical users and can explain the tradeoffs behind a systems decision in plain language.

Nice to Haves

• Experience implementing CPQ or billing systems
• Some Salesforce development experience (Apex, LWCs), enough to recognize when a declarative build is the wrong answer.
• Consulting background or experience working across multiple Salesforce orgs

What’s In It For You

- Global collaboration: Partner with teams and clients domestic and internationally.

- Competitive package: Comprehensive salary, benefits, and tools for success.

title: Account Executive
description:
ABOUT SITELINE

Siteline is a fast-growing Series A startup transforming how construction companies get paid, headquartered in San Francisco.

Specialty trade contractors build the infrastructure America runs on, from data centers and schools to highways and hospitals. Yet most are still managing millions of dollars in billing and payments through spreadsheets and manual processes.

We’re changing that.

WHAT PROBLEMS ARE WE SOLVING

Construction is the slowest paid industry, with contractors waiting around 96 days to get paid. For those 96 days, subcontractors are funding payroll, materials, equipment, and the cost of actually doing the work - all before seeing a single payment. It’s little wonder they describe themselves as “America’s largest bank”.

Our mission is simple: get subcontractors paid faster. And we’re damn good at it. Siteline customers average just 55 days to payment, and that number keeps falling.

We’re building in a massive, underserved market with no true direct competitor. And while AI is reshaping industries everywhere, the physical infrastructure our customers build isn’t going anywhere. Data centers, hospitals, schools, roads, and power infrastructure still have to be built -and the contractors building them need a radically better way to manage their receivables.

WHY ARE WE BUILDING THIS?

Construction software has historically been built for General Contractors. We’re building for the subcontractors actually doing the work.

These businesses are managing millions of dollars on spreadsheets, printouts, ERP reports, and a whole lot of manual work to get paid.

Every project has different billing requirements, different deadlines, and different paperwork. Miss something, and payment can get pushed out another 30 days.

Subcontractors deserve software built specifically for them. That’s why we built Siteline.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We’re looking for an Account Executive to join us at a pivotal stage of our growth. We’ve built a sales playbook that works, now we’re looking for great sellers to execute it and help us scale. The entire US is your territory. You’ll own deals end-to-end, work directly with our Head of Sales, and have close access to Marketing and Product as we continue to grow.

This is a role for someone who loves to sell; competitive, curious, coachable, and hungry to win. You love the hunt: prospecting, cold calling, creating your own pipeline, and turning a cold account into a closed deal.

You know how to create urgency, run a tight process, and close. You’ll get the upside and impact of an early-stage startup, with a proven playbook ready to execute.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

• 4+ years of closing experience as an AE in tech with a consistent track record of achieving sales targets (bonus: experience in construction technology)

• Experience selling $30k+ ACV deals in a quick sales cycle (30-60 days) to mid market companies

• Experience selling to finance functions (CFOs, Controllers, AR Managers) and/or tech laggard industries (AEC, manufacturing, agriculture, real estate, healthcare, etc.)

• Experience selling against the status quo - creating urgency and convincing customers to move away from spreadsheets, manual processes, or legacy systems.

• Ability to own the full sales cycle, from prospecting and discovery through demo, negotiation, and close.

• You’re a hunter. This is an outbound-first role, and you’ll self-source 50%+ of your pipeline through cold outreach, referrals, and creative prospecting. You have a track record of building and closing pipeline you generated yourself, and genuinely enjoy doing it.

• Comfortable working in a fast-paced, startup environment where cross-functional collaboration is key.

• Willingness to travel 10% for on-site demos and trade shows

• Bonus: Experience selling a product that integrates with ERPs

WHAT WE OFFER

title: Certified Weld Inspector (CWI) - Memphis
description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars.

SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to help humanity understand the universe. Our teams are building the full Super Intelligence stack: from our Colossus supercomputers, to Grok models, to our suite of applications, including Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X. We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next.

ABOUT THE ROLE:

We are seeking a Certified Weld Inspector to support the buildout of SpaceXSI's high-performance data centers. In this hands-on role, you will inspect welds on industrial piping and structural steel and keep quality moving on our next-generation AI supercomputing infrastructure.

You will work closely with welding, mechanical, structural, and operations teams to verify weld quality from construction through turnover. This is a full-time, onsite role with significant travel to SpaceXSI data center sites. This is an hourly position with overtime.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Inspect welds in progress and at completion on large-bore industrial piping and structural steel, and accept or reject them against the applicable code, welding procedure specification (WPS), and drawings.

• Interpret AWS, ASME, and project specifications against isometric, spool, structural, and arrangement drawings.

• Monitor GTAW, SMAW, FCAW, and GMAW work and confirm it is performed to the qualified welding procedure.

• Verify and document welder qualifications before a welder is released to weld on the package.

• Check joint design and preparation, fit-up, cleanliness, tack quality, preheat, interpass temperature, and interpass and final cleaning.

• Verify base metal and filler metal against the applicable specifications, including control and handling of welding consumables.

• Recommend and verify repairs, then visually inspect the completed repair before the joint is released.

• Oversee nondestructive examination and any required proof or mechanical testing, and confirm fabrication and inspection records are complete.

• Record inspection results and communicate findings to construction, welding, and engineering.

• Review contractor welding and inspection practices on site.

• Follow hot-work, LOTO, PPE, and site rules; report rejected welds, unsafe conditions, and drawing conflicts immediately.

• Support punch-list and NDE hold points through system turnover.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

• Current American Welding Society (AWS) Certified Welding Inspector (CWI) certification.

• High school diploma or equivalency certificate.

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

• Experience visually inspecting welded industrial piping and/or structural steel in the field.

• Working knowledge of ASME Section IX and AWS D1.1.

• Nondestructive testing Level II, in line with ASNT SNT-TC-1A, in visual testing (VT), magnetic particle (MT), liquid penetrant (PT), ultrasonic (UT), or phased array ultrasonic (PAUT).

• Prior experience on data center, industrial, or heavy-civil construction sites.

• Willingness to work at heights, outdoors, and on a changing data center construction site.

• Strong safety mindset and willingness to follow site procedures, including hot-work permits and inspection hold points.

title: Chief Legal Officer (CLO)
description:
Role Summary
The Chief Legal Officer (CLO) is the senior legal executive responsible for overseeing the organization's legal strategy, governance, regulatory compliance, corporate affairs, and risk management. The CLO serves as a trusted advisor to the CEO, Board of Directors, and executive leadership team, ensuring the organization operates within legal and regulatory frameworks while supporting business growth and strategic initiatives.
Key Responsibilities
1. Legal Strategy & Executive Advisory

• Serve as the principal legal advisor to the CEO, Board, and executive leadership team.

• Develop and execute the organization's legal strategy in alignment with business objectives.

• Provide legal guidance on strategic initiatives, mergers and acquisitions, partnerships, and corporate restructuring.

• Anticipate and mitigate legal risks associated with business operations and growth.

2. Corporate Governance

• Ensure compliance with corporate governance standards and best practices.

• Advise the Board and executive leadership on fiduciary responsibilities and governance matters.

• Manage board resolutions, corporate records, and governance policies.

• Support corporate secretarial functions where applicable.

3. Regulatory Compliance & Risk Management

• Oversee enterprise-wide legal and regulatory compliance programs.

• Ensure compliance with applicable laws, regulations, and industry standards.

• Monitor regulatory developments and assess their impact on the organization.

• Develop legal risk mitigation frameworks and compliance controls.

4. Contracts & Commercial Transactions

• Lead the negotiation, drafting, and review of significant commercial agreements.

• Oversee contract management processes and legal documentation standards.

• Provide legal support for strategic partnerships, vendor agreements, and customer contracts.

• Ensure contractual arrangements adequately protect organizational interests.

5. Litigation & Dispute Resolution

• Manage litigation strategy and external legal counsel relationships.

• Oversee dispute resolution, arbitration, mediation, and regulatory investigations.

• Assess litigation exposure and recommend appropriate legal actions.

• Ensure effective management of legal claims and liabilities.

6. Mergers, Acquisitions & Corporate Transactions

• Lead legal due diligence for mergers, acquisitions, joint ventures, and investments.

• Structure transactions to minimize legal and regulatory risk.

• Manage external advisors and legal workstreams throughout transaction lifecycles.

• Support post-merger integration activities from a legal perspective.

7. Ethics, Compliance & Corporate Integrity

• Promote a culture of ethics, integrity, and compliance.

• Oversee whistleblower programs, investigations, and ethics policies.

• Ensure adherence to anti-corruption, anti-bribery, and corporate conduct standards.

• Lead internal investigations involving legal and compliance matters.

8. Legal Team Leadership

• Build and lead a high-performing legal and compliance function.

• Manage legal budgets and external counsel expenditures.

• Develop legal talent and succession planning initiatives.

• Establish legal operations processes and performance metrics.

Qualifications & Experience

• Juris Doctor (JD), LLB, or equivalent law degree.

• Licensed attorney admitted to practice in a relevant jurisdiction.

• 15+ years of progressive legal experience.

• Minimum 5+ years in a senior legal leadership role (General Counsel, CLO, Head of Legal, Legal Director).

• Experience advising executive leadership and boards of directors.

• Strong background in corporate law, governance, compliance, commercial contracts, and regulatory matters.

• Experience managing complex legal transactions and litigation.

title: Senior Electrical Product Engineer - Maritime Engineering
tags: Maritime & Maneuver Dominance : Undersea Dominance - Engineering & Operations : Software Engineering
description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

About the Role

The Senior Product Engineer is the primary electrical design engineering presence on the production floor, bridging the gap between design intent and production execution. The role sits within Platform Engineering and is based primarily at the production site, dispositioning nonconformances and Material Review Board (MRB) actions for electrical systems and sub-assemblies, resolving design questions in real time, and closing the loop between production and design so that issues get root caused and fixed at the source. To hold that authority credibly, this role also contributes to upstream electrical design - architecture, analysis, schematics, and design reviews - so they have the depth needed to make sound disposition decisions on the floor. This is a senior individual contributor role requiring strong technical judgement in electrical and power systems engineering, the ability to operate autonomously in a fast-paced production environment, and the credibility to influence both design engineers and production teams. You will be expected to drive systemic improvements, cutting repeat nonconformances through changes to the design and documentation, as well as resolving individual issues.

Key Responsibilities

Production Floor Engineering Support

• Serve as the primary electrical design engineering point of contact on the production floor for assigned programs and product lines

• Represent the design authority at Material Review Board (MRB) for electrical systems, working with Quality and Manufacturing to minimise production hold time without compromising product safety and integrity

• Resolve production process-blockers, design ambiguities, and schematic/drawing interpretation issues in real time, exercising engineering judgement within defined authority boundaries

• Provide rapid-response engineering support and Root Cause Analysis (RCA) to Production, Quality, and Test teams for electrical nonconformance resolution, use-as-is/rework/scrap decisions, and repair dispositions

• Identify and escalate systemic electrical design issues to core Design Engineering teams with clear problem statements, data, and recommended corrective actions

• Perform detailed electrical calculations, simulations, and analysis to support MRB dispositions, deviation requests, and use-as-is justifications (e.g. power budgets, thermal derating, circuit analysis, connector/harness assessments)

Electrical Design Contribution

• Contribute to the design, development and integration of electrical systems and subsystems, maintaining the technical depth needed to hold disposition authority on the production floor

• Perform detailed electrical calculations, simulations and analysis (circuit analysis, power budgets, thermal derating, EMC/EMI) to support both design decisions and MRB dispositions

• Participate in design reviews (SRR, PDR, CDR) and contribute to system-level trade studies

• Collaborate cross-functionally with mechanical, software, and systems engineering to integrate electrical systems into the vehicle

Design Intent Translation & Multi-Site Support

• Support the translation of electrical design intent into production-executable work across multiple product versions, configurations, and manufacturing sites

title: Senior Manager, Retail Operations
description:
Skylight is a technology startup building the OS of the family. We make Skylight Calendar, the smart calendar loved by millions of families (plus Wired and Wirecutter). Calendar 2 launched earlier this year to rave reviews, and our newest product, Skylight Buddy, was just named one of TIME’s Best Inventions of 2026.
Our mission is to connect loved ones by creating the world’s simplest products and services that improve family life. Our founders are former venture capitalists and serial entrepreneurs who have scaled this business to $300M+ in annual revenue while being completely bootstrapped and profitable. We get to grow a happy, healthy company focused on making products our customers love without investors breathing down our necks.
Smart, hardworking people who care about making actually meaningful products love working here. People like you. We’re busy inventing new ways to simplify family life and help parents raise great kids - and we need your help! Come invent something new with us.
About the Role:
The Senior Manager Retail Operations will lead our retail operations team and own the long-term plan for how we ship to retailers. You will manage two Retail Operations Managers, who run the day to day for our retail accounts, and you will be the escalation point for retailer operations leaders when something goes wrong. You will also be the thought partner to our Senior Director of Global Fulfillment on the larger questions: which retailers to add, whether to go direct or through a distributor, how our systems and 3PL network should look in two years, and where our retail margin is leaking.
This is a player-coach role. About half your time is your team and the accounts; the other half is strategy and projects that need one owner. The ideal candidate has run retail operations for several national retailers, has coached managers, writes clearly, and can tell us when we are wrong.
Responsibilities:

• Lead and develop two Retail Operations Managers: set expectations, coach weekly, review their accounts, and build the standards they work to. Hire for the team as we grow.

• Own the retail operations strategy and 12-24 month roadmap: new retailers, new channels, international expansion, and the systems, 3PL capacity, and headcount needed to support them.

• Be the escalation point for retailer operations and vendor-compliance leaders. Run the quarterly reviews with our largest accounts alongside Sales.

• Own the cross-account scorecard: OTIF, fill rate, lead time, chargeback % of sales, freight cost per unit, and dispute win rate. Report it to leadership monthly with clear actions.

• Lead the chargeback and deduction prevention program: find recurring causes across retailers, fix them at the source with the 3PL and carriers, and quantify the savings.

• Own the retail order-to-cash process end to end with Sales, Accounting, and Planning: EDI (850 / 856 / 810), NetSuite, retailer portals, and where manual work should be automated.

• Work with Sales, Planning, and Purchasing on forecast-to-ship: how retailer forecasts turn into container loads, allocation rules, and inventory commitments.

• Work with the 3PL Manager on network design, site capacity, and retailer requirements at each warehouse.

• Evaluate build vs. buy and direct vs. distributor decisions with a clear business case, and present the recommendation to the executive team.

• Lead new retailer onboarding and large product launches as the single accountable owner.

• Own freight strategy for retail: broker and carrier mix, prepaid vs. collect, rates, and service.

• Build the operating rhythm: weekly team review, monthly business review, annual retailer compliance calendar.

Requirements

• Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Business Administration, or related field

• 8+ years of experience in retail fulfillment operations or supply chain management, including 3+ years leading retail logistics for national retailers

• 2+ years managing peopl

title: Software Engineer 5 – Agent Platform, AI Platform
description:
At Netflix , our mission is to entertain the world. Together, we are writing the next episode - pushing the boundaries of storytelling, global fandom and making the unimaginable a reality. We are a dream team obsessed with the uncomfortable excitement of discovering what happens when you merge creativity, intuition and cutting-edge technology. Come be a part of what’s next.
At Netflix , we want to entertain the world, and we're constantly innovating on how entertainment is imagined, created, and delivered to a global audience. Increasingly, that innovation is powered by AI - and Netflix is making a deliberate bet to become AI Native, with AI woven into how we build products, create content, and run the company.
The Opportunity
The Agent Platform team gives Netflix engineers the infrastructure to go from zero to a production-grade AI agent without reinventing the wheel. We own the foundational building blocks the whole company builds on: the Model Gateway (unified access to external LLMs like Claude, GPT, and Gemini), the Assistance API for conversational use cases, the MCP Gateway that connects agents to Netflix 's internal systems and knowledge, our Agent SDK, and an end-to-end evaluation stack.
The work has moved well beyond chat completions. Teams across Netflix are now building agents - systems that plan, call tools, observe results, and iterate - and they depend on us for the infrastructure to do that reliably and to know whether their agents are actually any good. We're a small team with outsized leverage: what we ship becomes the foundation for AI across all of Netflix .
What you will do:

• Design, build, and operate the Agent SDK and MCP Gateway that Netflix engineers use to build, deploy, and run AI agents in production.

• Build agents and agent infrastructure across the full lifecycle - plan/act/observe loops, tool and MCP integrations, deployment, and day-2 operations.

• Make evaluation a first-class part of the platform: build the tracing, eval suites, and quality signals that let teams measure agents, catch regressions, and iterate to make them better.

• Own reliability, observability, and guardrails for non-deterministic systems running at very high scale

• Lead cross-functional initiatives with ML scientists, data scientists, product managers, and other AI Platform teams.

• Rapidly iterate with users to improve the developer experience while establishing durable foundational capabilities.

Desired Background:

• 8+ years of software engineering experience with a track record of delivering quality results.

• Hands-on experience building, deploying, operating, AND evaluating LLM agents in production - not just chat-completion apps or prototypes.

• Experience with one or more agent frameworks/SDKs (Strands, OpenAI Agents SDK, Anthropic Claude Agent SDK, LangGraph, pydantic-ai, CrewAI, Google ADK) and with tool/function calling and MCP.

• Experience with LLM/agent evaluation and observability - building eval suites, tracing, and quality measurement, then iterating on results (Braintrust, LangSmith, W&B, or equivalent).

• Strong experience building SDKs and APIs for internal or external developers.

• Strong fundamentals in building and operating scalable, observable, fault-tolerant distributed systems.

• Proficiency in Python (and Python packaging tooling) plus one of Java, Go, C/C++, Rust, or Zig. Familiarity with our stack - Temporal, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, Kubernetes - is a plus.

• Experience with large-scale build, release, CI/CD, and observability methods.

Generally, our compensation structure consists solely of an annual salary; we do not have bonuses. You choose each year how much of your compensation you want in salary versus stock options. To determine your personal top of market compensation, we rely on market indicators and consider your specific job family, background, skills, and experience to determine your compensation in the market range. The range for this role is $466,000.00 - $750,000.0

title: Product Manager, Server Experience & Fulfillment (Canada)

About Proof

Proof is the service-of-process marketplace modernizing how legal documents move through the real world. 10,000 law firms, from small practices to the AmLaw 100, trust us with documents that have legal consequences: a serve has to reach the right person, at the right address, under the right rules, with a court-ready affidavit proving what happened.

We're one of the fastest-growing tech enabled services companies in the U.S., and legal tech is one of the most exciting places to build software right now. We're also still early enough that you'll help shape the culture, not just inherit it. Expect real autonomy, the latest AI tools on a modern stack, plus engineers and designers who care about craft as much as you do.

The role

Due process starts at a door. Before a lawsuit can move forward, the person being sued has to be properly notified, and for thousands of cases every day, that happens through a process server using our mobile app. It's one of the most critical steps in the litigation system.

As a Product Manager on the Server Experience and Fulfilment team, you'll own the product experience that helps those servers get it right and on time, from understanding requirements and planning attempts to capturing reliable evidence of service. Your goal is to make that work easier for servers, more predictable for the law firms relying on it, and more profitable for our marketplace overall.

What you'll own

• Planning and attempts. How servers plan their day, sequence attempts, work high-volume addresses, and see which jobs are at risk before a deadline passes.

• Job requirements. Helping servers act on each job's legal requirements at the right moment, across states and counties.

• Evidence of service. The capture and verification behind every attempt: location, time, photos, eligibility checks. Raise the quality bar without slowing servers down, even with no signal.

• Fewer handoffs. Deciding what belongs in the app, what AI and automation can handle, and what still needs one of our service specialists.

• Efficient dispatch. How job offers get packaged, priced, and distributed to servers, and the product systems behind server pay.

Your team and scope

You're joining an established team that has driven some of Proof's biggest wins over the last two years. It moves quickly, ships with impact, and has built a best-in-class mobile app for process servers.

You'll report to the CPO and, as a hands-on IC, partner with a dedicated engineering squad and our design team on discovery, analysis, and delivery. You're accountable for the squad's multi-quarter roadmap. Day to day, you'll work side by side with a world-class operations team that handles server recruitment, rate negotiation, and risk and compliance, and with four other PMs who lead the law firm experience, platform automation, filing, and integrations.

What success looks like in year one

• More jobs meet their service deadlines, without more avoidable reattempts.

• Less avoidable specialist work per job, with service quality continuing to improve.

• More complete, trustworthy evidence from the field, and fewer downstream corrections caused by missing or incorrect server inputs.

• Servers find the work easier, and it shows in retention: more of our best servers stay active and take on more jobs.
